communes: Santo Antão E São Julião Do Tojal

blurb.text: An area north of Lisbon known for white wine made only from Arinto, Rabo de Ovelha and Sercial. It is noted for cool fermentation. Its whites were once likened in London to Rhine Riesling and called Portuguese hock.
